body: I've been able to create a minimal testcase for this. It appears to bubble up from the functiion @laszlocsomor linked not handling SkyFunctions.EXTERNAL_PACKAGE. -- a test that can create those conditions is available at https://github.com/AmandaCameron/bazel-1793-example
@laurentlb Could you take a look please? The exception is coming from a Skylark-related class.

@laurentlb You have an excuse this week :)
@vladmos Could you please take a look?

I think this IllegalStateException happens when there's a circular dependency using load(). We've already noticed this problem in the past. We should look at it soon and provide a better error message.

Thanks for the report!

issue.title: `load`ing a non-existent external in `WORKSPACE` yields an `IllegalStateException`

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
If you attempt to load a `.bzl` file from a non-existent external, `bazel` dies with an inscrutable `IllegalStateException`, instead of a more helpful error message.

```
[nelhage@monomorphique:/tmp/bazelbug]$ cat WORKSPACE
load("@some_external//:rules.bzl", "some_rule")
[nelhage@monomorphique:/tmp/bazelbug]$ bazel query //...
.

PACKAGE:external

cycle:
```
